thread:
Marie K.: Hey team — want to lock down the social plan for the benchmark + webinar push. Webinar is 5/12 10am PT. Need: teaser posts, hero creative, X thread, LinkedIn copy, and routing for inbound signups. @Jess - can you own assets?
AJ: tagging. For timing — my suggestion: X teases 2x (1 week out, 2 days out), LinkedIn long-form 3 days out + day-of reminder. Best windows: X at 11:30am PT, LinkedIn 9am ET.
Jess - Content: Got it. Will request: 15s clip (loopable), 1:1 gif for X, 16:9 hero for LinkedIn, and a 4-tweet thread with CTAs. ETA for first drafts: EOD Tue. Any required brand lines?
Marie K.: Use "Redwood Inference: inference optimized for production" as headline. Include benchmark hook: "2x cost reduction at p50 latency in real workloads" — that's our narrative but keep it TBD on exact stat until legal clears.
Sam T.: On routing — can we ensure the registration form tags by source and assigns to SDR queue? Use campaign=benchmark_webinar_5_12 and source param x or linkedin. Example UTM: `?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=benchmark_webinar_5_12&utm_medium=social`
Sam T.: Also need to create a HubSpot workflow that assigns new signups from this campaign to the inbound-webinar-APR queue and pings #sales-inbound with name + company. @AJ can you confirm SDR owners?
AJ: Confirmed. SDR rotation: Nora / Ben / Diego. Use round-robin. HubSpot workflow: create property "webinar_campaign" and set routing rules. I'll coordinate with Ops to test.
Leo G.: For engagement follow-ups: plan a 24-hour post-engagement play — comment-first strategy, then DM for top eng leads. I'll draft two engagement prompts: one for X comments, one for LinkedIn comments.
Jess - Content: Draft copies below. A (tease): "We benchmarked open LLMs in production — saw big wins. Join our webinar 5/12 to see how. Register -> <short.link> #inference #mlops"
Jess - Content: B (technical hook): "Latency matters. Cost matters. We ran a production benchmark: p50 latency vs cost tradeoffs. Live demo + deep dive 5/12. Register: <short.link>"
Marie K.: Both good. Prefer B for LinkedIn lead post, A for X teaser. Minor edit: add "Q&A with engineers" to B.
Jess - Content: Updated B: "Latency matters. Cost matters. We ran a production benchmark: p50 latency vs cost tradeoffs. Live demo + Q&A with engineers 5/12. Register: <short.link>"
Sam T.: For the X thread, propose we surface 3 quick bullets: baseline, our optimization, what attendees will learn. Example thread skeleton: 1) hook, 2) benchmark stat (TBD), 3) tech highlight (kv caching/batching), 4) CTA + link.
Marie K.: Good. @Jess can you fill the 4 tweets and tag engineers: @leo, @sam for quotes?
Jess - Content: Will do. Also need final brand-approved stat by Thu noon or we run with qualitative wording. Please confirm legal signoff timeline.
AJ: I'll ping Legal. If no stat by Thu noon, we use "meaningful cost reductions" phrasing.
ops-bot: Scheduling slots available: 2026-05-05 11:30 PT (X teaser 1), 2026-05-10 11:30 PT (X teaser 2), 2026-05-09 09:00 ET (LinkedIn long-form), 2026-05-12 09:00 ET (day-of LinkedIn reminder). Reply with slot numbers to reserve.
Marie K.: Reserve all suggested slots. Jess & AJ — please confirm creative & copy by Fri COB so ops can schedule.
Jess - Content: Confirming EOD Tue drafts, final by Fri COB. Will upload to /assets/social/webinar_5_12/ with filenames: hero_16x9_v1.png, clip_15s_v1.mp4, thread_copy_v1.md
Leo G.: Engagement follow-ups: drafting comment prompts now. Also propose a short template for SDR follow-up DM: "Hey {name}, saw you registered for our benchmark webinar — curious what latency or cost question you're most focused on?"
Sam T.: Sounds good. Add sequence: 1) immediate confirmation email, 2) 24h pre-webinar reminder, 3) post-webinar follow-up with recording + survey, and 4) qualified lead handoff note to assigned SDR.
Marie K.: Perfect. One last ask — use UTMs and set a hidden property in HubSpot to capture "social_touch=benchmark_5_12" so we can measure downstream MQLs.
Sam T.: Will add property. AJ will help with HubSpot tests.
AJ: I'll run a test submission by Thu and post results in this thread.
Marie K.: Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers with creative or legal, flag here. :sparkles:
AJ: Quick FYI — plan an experiment: A/B the X teaser copy for CTR (A = product-focused, B = people/story). We'll report performance 48h after each post.
Jess - Content: noted. I'll prepare both variations.
ops-bot: Slots reserved and queued for approval: IDs 98321, 98322, 98323, 98324. Scheduler will publish after final confirm and legal waiver.
Marie K.: That's a wrap for now. We'll reconvene Thu morning if legal hasn't returned.
AJ: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
